USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (2025, US Gov Public Domain): Gold is globally diversified across China (~12%), Australia, Canada, and Japan/Korea refining hubs, used extensively in semiconductor wire bonding and corrosion-resistant connectors.

USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (2025, US Gov Public Domain): The Democratic Republic of the Congo and Rwanda together supply over 60% of global primary tantalum ore used in high-capacitance electronic capacitors and semiconductor barrier layers; U.S. net import reliance is 100% for primary tantalum.

USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (2025, US Gov Public Domain): China and Indonesia together account for nearly half of global refined tin supply critical for lead-free electronics solder across server boards, GPUs, and mobile SoCs; U.S. net import reliance is ~77%.

USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries (2025, US Gov Public Domain): China accounts for approximately 81% of global primary tungsten mine production and dominates ammonium paratungstate (APT) refining used in semiconductor metallization, aerospace tooling, and high-density contacts; U.S. net import reliance exceeds 50%.
